cs.content: Studentům bude podrobně představena problematika nutriční ekologie fytofágního hmyzu, se zaměřením na vliv kvality potravy při procesu vývoje nebo aktivity konkrétních modelových druhů. en.label: Mode of delivery for our mobility students abroad:
en.content: According to the planned online consultations with garant and subject teachers, students will study in detail the nutritional ecology of phytophagous insects by self-study (with a focus on the influence of food quality during the development process or the activity of specific model species). For the student's absence from practical teaching (a practical experiment will not be carried out with the monitoring of the parameters of the population of larval or adult individuals of the model insect species, such as the speed of development, the duration of individual instars, etc.), the attention of students will be devoted to compiling a review on the issue in question - a specific topic and form will result from regular online consultations with garant and subject teachers.

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: Students will be introduced in detail to the issue of nutritional ecology of phytophagous insects, focusing on the impact of food quality in the process of development or activity of specific model species. The practical experiment, which will focus on monitoring the parameters of larval populations of a selected model insect species, such as the rate of development, duration of individual instars, etc., will be realized.

en.content: 1.Structure of the digestive system of insects (allowance 1/2)2.Morphology of the insect mouthparts (allowance 1/0)3.Anatomy of the digestive system (allowance 2/0)4.Digestion of food (allowance 4/0)5.Osmoregulation and excretion of metabolism (allowance 4/0)6.Reaction of model species of phytophagous insects to changes in the quality of their food (allowance 0/8)7.Preparation and implementation of a laboratory experiment focusing on the influence of food quality in the process of phytophagous insect development (allowance 0/14)
